subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the workflow guards are repaired, does openclaw/openclaw-secops approve the CodeQL and dependency-guard action updates?
rationale: The PR carries the protected security label and modifies workflow paths explicitly assigned to the secops owner, so automation cannot make the final security-boundary decision.

options.title: Repair and approve
options.body: Update the stale guard constant, rerun exact-head checks, and approve the verified pins after secops review.

options.title: Split security pins
options.body: Move CodeQL and dependency-guard revisions to a separate security-reviewed PR if they should not block routine dependency updates.

recommendation.title: Repair and approve
recommendation.body: Update the stale guard constant, rerun exact-head checks, and approve the verified pins after secops review.

likelyOwner.reason: This team is the explicit CODEOWNER for the changed security workflow paths.
